description: For Orb Studio radar stories of the last 7 days with at least 3 outlets: the time each outlet joined, shape wave / cascade / mixed, per radar, with the longest cascades and the biggest waves. The shape says how a story spread, not why: a wave may be one wire feed. Outlets are not independent confirmations. Times are the feeds' own and can be wrong. No AI. In honour of Johannes Schmidt (1843-1901), author of the wave theory in linguistics.
name: get_schmidt
title: Schmidt sensor: do outlets join a radar story as a chain of retellings (tree) or all at once (wave)
